blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Miss Asia Pacific International third runner-up Gabrielle Galapia shared that nobody prepared her for being the host-delegate before she embarked on her global pageant journey. A pageant veteran in the local circuit, the Kapampangan lass got her first international assignment after receiving her national title in June, just four months since placing as Second Princess at the 2026 Miss World Philippines competition. But unlike most of the country’s international delegates whose global pageants are outside the Philippines, Galapia had the convenience of staying in familiar territory.
